**Hypothesis (natural-language, data-grounded):**
On the standardised PCA of the 12 Z-valued forms of capital in `data/capital.csv` (PC1 explaining 30.3% of the variance, fit on all 39 hundred-year slices 4300-500 BCE), the Younger Bronze Age (YBA) row at **1100 BCE** has a PC1 score of **-4.45**, which sits **clearly below** (more negative than) the entire range of PC1 scores for the subsequent 1000-500 BCE horizons (range [-2.15, -0.78], mean -1.41). The single-horizon 1100-to-1000 BCE drop on PC1 is **about 3.04 PC1 units**, i.e. roughly **5.3 sample-sigma** of the spread of the later YBA points, and the 1100 BCE row lies outside the [min,max] interval of the 1000-500 BCE distribution on PC1.

The variables that drive 1100 BCE to this low PC1 value (largest negative loadings on PC1, i.e. highest at 1100 BCE) are **CopperGold (ZCU_AU, -0.78)**, followed by **PotteryDecoration (Zkeverz, -0.73)**, **Depot (ZHort, -0.65)**, **HatchetSword (ZAxtSchwert, -0.57)**, **Dagger (ZDolch, -0.51)**, **MonumentSize (ZMW, -0.46)**, **HouseSize (Zhausgr, -0.43)** and **MonumentCount (ZMonument, -0.39)**. The same direction and magnitude are reproduced by three robustness checks: raw (un-standardised) covariance (-3.01 unit gap), PCA after dropping ZSichel and ZKeform (constant in YBA, -3.46 unit gap, -5.7 sigma), and PCA fit on YBA-only (-6.24 unit gap).

**YBA PC1/PC2 (CSV):**

| BCE | PC1     | PC2     |
|-----|---------|---------|
| 1100 | -4.4475 | -0.2653 |
| 1000 | -2.1480 |  1.5674 |
|  900 | -1.6274 |  1.3971 |
|  800 | -1.8944 |  1.1472 |
|  700 | -1.2253 |  1.0214 |
|  600 | -0.7999 |  1.3322 |
|  500 | -0.7786 |  1.6712 |

The PC1 values from 1000 BCE forward rise gradually toward zero (-2.15 -> -0.78), but never return to the very negative level observed at 1100 BCE, so the start of the Younger Bronze Age stands apart as a single-horizon excess of capital along PC1.

### Artifacts
- `artifacts/analysis.py` — Executable analysis pipeline (load/clean via European-comma parsing, standardise, `numpy.linalg.eigh` PCA, project, 3 robustness variants, JSON dump).
- `artifacts/analysis.ipynb` — Executed notebook (nbformat 4, 10 cells, code with stream outputs and markdown summary).
- `artifacts/yba_pc1.csv` — 7 YBA rows with columns `BCE, PC1, PC2`.
- `artifacts/results_summary.json` — Eigenvalues, loadings, YBA PC1 scores, 1100-vs-later comparison metrics for primary + 3 robustness variants.
